Subject: Request: Pilot onboarding — invoice-only & PO exception

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to get FastMetrics into a small pilot with your ML infra team. Our procurement team asked that I surface a request early: can Redwood onboard FastMetrics on an invoice-only path for this pilot (no PO), with monthly invoices? The pilot scope is small — $1,800/mo for a 3-month trial (est. total $5,400) while we validate latency/cost assumptions.

We can sign the SOW and provide vendor paperwork (W-9, insurance) immediately. Contractually, we can agree to standard Redwood terms for the pilot and accept a short trial addendum if needed.

Attachments: FastMetrics_SOW_v2.pdf, FastMetrics_W9.pdf

Please let me know the next steps and whether Redwood can approve a no-PO onboarding for this specific pilot.

Thanks,

Hi Ben / Olivia — thanks for the details. Pulling procurement guidance together below.

Quick background: Redwood's standard onboarding requires a PO for recurring services. We do allow temporary invoice-only onboarding for small pilots under an exception process. The criteria we consider:
- Total committed spend for the pilot (cap)
- Duration (trial length)
- Vendor paperwork completeness (W-9, insurance, contact)
- Commercial/Legal signoff on SOW or trial addendum
- Finance confirmation for payment terms and GL code

Given FastMetrics' proposed numbers ($1.8k/mo, 3 months), Procurement is open to a conditional exception provided the following are submitted:
1) Completed procurement_exception_form.pdf (attached)
2) Vendor tax docs (W-9 received) and a sample invoice (or template)
3) Signed SOW or a DocuSign link to the signed SOW

Proposed internal guardrails for approval:
- Invoice-only allowed for pilot up to $3,000/month and up to 90 days.
- No automatic renewal: any extension requires a PO or renewed exception.
- FastMetrics invoices must reference the Redwood GL code / budget code (Logan to confirm).

If the vendor requests >90 days or >$3k/month we escalate to manager approval. Laura, please flag any legal concerns — otherwise Procurement will create the exception request ticket once Olivia returns the filled form and invoice sample.
